Request body size limit middleware. Rejects requests exceeding a configurable body size with 413 Payload Too Large.Generic 413 body. Intentionally omits the configured limit so internal per-type policy is not disclosed to clients.Default options: 1 MiB max body size with no per-type limits.Validate per-type entries; negative maxBytes raises ValueError, empty and wildcard tokens are skipped, and duplicates keep the first entry.Return the max bytes for an exact content-type token match, else defaultMax.No-allocation variant that tokenizes a FastStringView content-type header in place before matching entries.

Rejects requests whose body exceeds a configurable size with 413.

This is a processing guard: it prevents downstream parsing of oversized bodies. uSockets buffers the full request body before the middleware chain runs, so maxBodySize/bodySpillThreshold on the server are the actual buffering guards; configure maxBodySize >= this limit so the 413 path is reachable. maxBytes <= 0 on the options overload means "no body allowed"; the bodyLimit(int) overload clamps to at least 1 byte.

Convenience overload building the middleware from a plain byte count, clamped to at least 1 byte.
